code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
      'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def fasta(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
def win(s,w=19):
    return np.array([sum(KD.get(a,0) for a in s[i:i+w])/w for i in range(len(s)-w+1)])

seqs={"LNP1 human A1A4G5":fasta("A1A4G5"),
      "LNPK lunapark Q9C0E8":fasta("Q9C0E8"),
      "AQP1 P29972":fasta("P29972"),
      "SEC61B P60468":fasta("P60468")}
pdb=open("out/AF-A1A4G5.pdb").read()
plddt=[float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
fam=pd.read_csv("out/LNP1_family_scan.csv"); core=fam[(fam.length>=160)&(fam.length<=230)]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,8))
a=ax[0,0]
for k,c in zip(seqs,["#C0392B","#2E86C1","#148F77","#884EA0"]):
    y=win(seqs[k]); a.plot(np.arange(len(y))+10, y, label=k, lw=1.6, color=c)
a.axhline(1.6, ls="--", color="k", lw=1); a.text(5,1.75,"TM threshold (KD 1.6)",fontsize=8)
a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, 19-aa window")
a.set_title("LNP1 has no hydrophobic window reaching the TM threshold"); a.legend(fontsize=7)

a=ax[0,1]
a.plot(np.arange(1,len(plddt)+1), plddt, color="#1F618D", lw=1.4)
for t,c in [(90,"#2ECC71"),(70,"#F39C12"),(50,"#E74C3C")]: a.axhline(t, ls=":", color=c, lw=1)
a.set_ylim(0,100); a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
a.set_title("AlphaFold AF-A1A4G5-F1: mean pLDDT %.1f, no folded core" % np.mean(plddt))

a=ax[1,0]
bench=pd.read_csv("out/tm_benchmark_panel.csv")
a.barh(range(len(bench)), bench.maxGES19, color=["#C0392B" if "LNP1 h" in p else "#5D6D7E" for p in bench.protein])
a.set_yticks(range(len(bench))); a.set_yticklabels([p[:34] for p in bench.protein], fontsize=7)
a.axvline(20, ls="--", color="k", lw=1); a.text(21,0.2,"membrane-insertion\nthreshold ~ +20",fontsize=7)
a.set_xlabel("max GES transfer free energy over 19-aa window (kcal/mol)")
a.set_title("LNP1 is far below the membrane-insertion threshold")

a=ax[1,1]
a.hist(core.GRAVY, bins=25, color="#5D6D7E")
a.axvline(-1.517, color="#C0392B", lw=2); a.text(-1.5,a.get_ylim()[1]*0.8," human LNP1",color="#C0392B",fontsize=8)
a.set_xlabel("GRAVY"); a.set_ylabel("count")
a.set_title("GRAVY of %d LNP1-family orthologs (160-230 aa)\nall hydrophilic, mean %.2f" % (len(core), core.GRAVY.mean()))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
